content.title: About
content.content: A vegetable sandwich on white bread consists of fresh vegetables (tomato, cucumber, lettuce, pepper), a slice of cheese and a light sauce, placed between two soft white bread slices. It is suitable for a light snack or a quick lunch.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: White bread provides a soft, neutral base that lets the bright flavors of the vegetables shine.
Vegetables are often served raw in the sandwich, preserving maximum vitamins and a crunchy texture.
This sandwich is popular in vegetarian and vegan diets when the cheese is replaced with a plant‑based alternative.
It is easily adaptable – avocado, hummus or pickled veggies can be added for extra flavor.
White‑bread sandwiches are commonly served in school cafeterias and fast‑food cafés.

items.title: Rich in vitamins
items.content: Fresh vegetables supply vitamins A, C, K and folate.

items.title: Source of fiber
items.content: Vegetables and any added seeds boost dietary fiber, supporting digestion.

items.title: Low‑calorie
items.content: A white‑bread sandwich is generally modest in calories, making it a good option for weight management.

items.title: Hydration
items.content: High‑water vegetables like cucumber and tomato help maintain the body’s fluid balance.

items.title: Antioxidant properties
items.content: Compounds such as lycopene and carotenoids in the veggies act as antioxidants.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Some individuals may be allergic to cheese, seeds (e.g., sesame) or sauces.

items.title: Sodium content
items.content: Prepared sauces or salty cheese can raise the sodium level.

items.title: Hygiene
items.content: Fresh vegetables should be thoroughly washed to avoid food‑borne illness.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: White bread contains gluten, so the sandwich is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Eat the sandwich right after assembling, cutting it in half if desired. It is convenient to take it on the go in a wrapper or parchment paper. Optional additions include mustard, hummus or a light yogurt sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store the prepared sandwich in the refrigerator in an airtight container for no more than 24 hours. The bread may become soft, so it is best to assemble the sandwich shortly before eating.
